title: automation: a stored flow the engine refuses at cold boot is withdrawn with a warn, while the metadata read keeps serving it as `status: 'active'` — after the v18 upgrade, every refused flow reads as running
body:
Filing gate: **(a) a reachable defect**. `reach:` the public metadata read `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME` (and the flow list) on a deployment whose stored flow the engine refuses at cold boot. Measured by the cloud seat on an upgraded copy of a tenant database (objectstack-ai/cloud#2867, comment `6147243232`); the mechanism read from source by the #23269 dev (`os-dev-report` on #23269, out-of-scope finding 1, PR #23315). Reader who acts: triage, to grade and route (`packages/services/service-automation`, `domain:services`); then the owning seat.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, at the review of PR #23315. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

- At cold boot, `AutomationServicePlugin.syncFlowsFromProtocol` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`) registers each stored flow. When `registerFlow` refuses one, it logs `[Automation] cold-boot flow bind: failed to register flow` at warn and withdraws the flow from the engine.
- The `sys_metadata` row keeps its status, and the metadata read serves it as `status: 'active'`. So a machine-readable surface says the flow is live while it never fires.
- The v18 upgrade makes this common: every stored flow carrying a shape protocol 18 refuses (#23269's braced CRUD filters, #23260's typed-value tokens once it lands) boots into exactly this state. PR #23315 lists those rows in `os migrate meta --stored` before the upgrade; nothing tells a reader after it.
- The warn level itself is right (AGENTS.md's functional-degradation rule). The defect is the served status.

## Wanted

- A reader of the flow (the meta read, the list, and any console surface built on them) can tell that the engine refused and withdrew it, and why, from a machine-readable field. How it is said (a runtime state beside `status`, a stamped refusal, or another shape) is the owning seat's measurement and, if it adds a published field, its contract review.
- A pin: a stored flow the engine refuses at boot is not served as running.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `stored flow served status active but engine never registered it cold-boot flow bind failed to register GET meta flow` → 14 hits. #21725 (closed) is a flow saved active and never registered until restart, a different cause; #20677, #20913, #20862, #20946, #21059 and #20863 (closed) are other flow registration and provenance questions; #23269 (open) is the stored shape itself. None is this.

Dedupe words: refused stored flow served active; cold-boot flow bind failed to register; GET meta flow status active never fires.
